Kyung Hee's ChatKHU usage guide describes ChatKHU as a university-only generative AI platform available to currently enrolled or employed members, with monthly credits for students, faculty, and staff.

Kyung Hee's ChatKHU guide instructs members not to enter or upload personal information, unpublished important data, research data, evaluation materials, or confidential university documents into ChatKHU or external AI tools.
Kyung Hee's ChatGPT guideline says students should follow instructor guidance and recognize that undisclosed or direct submission of ChatGPT output can constitute misconduct.
Kyung Hee's ChatGPT guideline tells instructors to decide ChatGPT use standards for a course and state the applicable guidance in the syllabus.
